Why should you join?DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.Your ResponsibilitiesWe're looking for a Design Systems Engineer to take ownership of our design system's end-to-end pipeline — from design tokens in Figma, through automated token transformation and component libraries, to visual-regression-gated delivery in production. This person sits at the seam between design and engineering: fluent enough in design to argue token semantics with designers, and strong enough in code to ship the infrastructure that turns design decisions into shippable, tested components.This is the kind of role where one day you're reconciling a naming conflict between Figma and code, and the next you're diagnosing why a component renders differently in production. You'll be the steward of the system that every product team builds on top of.Your responsibilities:• Owning the design token pipeline, you keep Figma as the single source of truth and drive tokens through to consumable CSS/SCSS variables and a component library, while managing primitive → semantic → component token tiers, naming conventions, and the inevitable gaps and conflicts.• The component library is yours to build and maintain, as you review components against design specs, fix fidelity issues, and govern variants and APIs.• In this role, you run design-to-code automation, programmatically extract tokens and component context from Figma, and build tooling (including AI-assisted workflows) that reduces the manual work of keeping design and code in sync.• As the owner of visual-regression and accessibility infrastructure, you maintain a CI-integrated pipeline (visual diffing + automated a11y checks) with baseline management and PR gating, hosted on cloud infrastructure in collaboration with our DevOps teams and our Azure cloud infrastructure.• When migrations are on the table, you lead the technical parts of component and token migrations by planning and executing phased rollouts that swap legacy components for the modern system spec-by-spec, with explicit sign-off and before/after evidence, while protecting backward compatibility.• By documenting and transferring knowledge, you keep architecture decisions and conventions written down so the system stays maintainable beyond any one person.What you need to succeed• Several years of design system experience equip you to succeed, ideally gained on a cross-platform design system.• Your TypeScript and modern frontend skills are strong, and you are comfortable in Angular and web components (e.g., Lit).• Your CSS/SCSS craft is solid.• Hands-on experience with design tokens—including token architecture, semantic tiers, and tooling such as Tokens Studio, W3C DTCG, or Style Dictionary (or equivalent)—is part of your toolkit.• You demonstrate real Figma fluency, from reading design systems, variables/collections, and component libraries to using the Figma API/plugin ecosystem for programmatic extraction.• Your CI/CD and cloud delivery experience covers pipelines, package publishing to private feeds, and hosting build artifacts and tooling, with Azure experience (Static Web Apps, Container Apps, Blob Storage, Entra ID) considered a plus.• Modernizing legacy frontends incrementally without breaking consumers is something you have done.• You are curious and passionate about AI-assisted design and engineering workflows.• A proactive approach to solving problems defines how you work.• You have excellent communication skills in English, and German is a plus.What we can offerThere are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:• Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.• Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.• Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).• Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.• Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.• Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.• Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.• Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).• Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.• Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.• Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!• We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.• Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.• We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.• Up to 30 Days Work from With a strong focus on back-office execution, you will prepare tailored, data-driven demos and deeply investigate customer-specific use cases to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value realization.• Prepare and configure tailored demos on customer data to support pre-sales activities and showcase platform capabilities• Investigate and resolve customer-specific use cases and edge cases during onboarding and adoption• Collaborate with sales and customer-facing teams to translate RFQ evaluation workflows into effective platform configurations• Support the implementation of collaborative requirements elicitation processes within the platform• Perform initial legacy data ingestion using Python-based ETL workflows where required• Utilize Python-based APIs for data integration and platform setup• Troubleshoot data, document processing, and workflow-related issues• Document solutions, patterns, and best practices to improve scalability and reuseYour profile• Strong hands-on experience with data preparation, ETL processes, and enterprise datasets• Proficiency in Python, including scripting for data processing and API interactions• Ability to analyze complex customer scenarios and translate them into structured solutions• Detail-oriented, with a strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently• Comfortable working in a jobs.description: Who are weAs a biotechnology company, at Insempra we don’t simply hope for a better future – we actively work to create one.For far too long, companies have relied on chemical production processes, depleting our planet’s limited resources in the process. jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.109407 | Asset & Investment Management | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentThe Private Markets Solutions Team designs and manages diversified private markets portfolios across bespoke mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives and market views into allocation, portfolio construction and investment decisions. Working across private equity, private debt, infrastructure, and selectively real estate, the team partners with specialist investment teams to access their deal flow in primaries, co-investments and secondaries while also investing in the platform's direct strategies and performing selective, complementary sourcing. The team retains end-to-end responsibility for portfolio strategy, pacing, investment decisions and ongoing portfolio steering. The team is part of risklab, the solutions pillar of Allianz Global Investors' global investment platform, and works closely with other risklab teams, on modelling of private markets, strategic asset allocation advice, and holistic public-private portfolios.The Associate Portfolio Manager takes ownership of defined portfolio-management responsibilities across diversified private markets mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives, portfolio analysis and market views into actionable allocation and investment recommendations. In addition, the role helps develop the team's investment strategy capability by producing cross-asset-class research, relative-value assessments and investment theses that inform portfolio decisions.What you will do- Manage defined portfolio workstreams - and progressively portfolios - across private equity, private debt, infrastructure and real estate, under the oversight of senior portfolio managers.- Develop allocation, pacing and portfolio-construction recommendations based on client objectives, portfolio exposures, cash-flow forecasts and investment guidelines.- Evaluate investment opportunities in a total-portfolio context and formulate clear recommendations for portfolio reviews and investment committees.- Develop market views, relative-value assessments and investment theses across private markets, working closely with specialist investment teams.- Translate investment research and market developments into practical implications for portfolio allocation, construction and steering with the clear aim to generate extra returns.- Take ownership of high-quality portfolio analyses and decision materials, coordinating inputs across investment teams and functions and delivering reliably under tight deadlines.- Improve investment frameworks, analytical tools and team processes, while guiding analysts on assigned workstreams.What you bring- Master's degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, business administration or another quantitative discipline; a PhD, CFA and/or CAIA qualification is an advantage.- 3-5 years of relevant experience in private markets, investment management/ consulting or investment/ academic research; demonstrable private markets expertise is required.- Strong understanding of private-markets investment and portfolio-management concepts, ideally across more than one asset class.- Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret portfolio data, market research and cash-flow analysis and turn them into actionable investment recommendations.- Proven ability to conduct independent research, develop investment views and communicate clear, well-supported conclusions to senior stakeholders and investment committees.- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with data-analysis or visualisation tools is an advantage.- Structured, reliable and quality-focused, with the ability to take ownership of complex workstreams and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.- Flexible, proactive and self-reliant, with the judgement to manage changing priorities, identify issues and drive work forward with limited supervision.- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the confidence to challenge constructively and work effectively across asset classes, investment teams and functions.- Fluent verbal and written skills in both English and German required.- Experience with Data Analytics, Data Modelling and Microsoft CoPilot.
